title: Como ele anda sozinho
concept: Blueprint FIG. 4: a top-down hunt map; the KizuBot marker records the route once (REC), the route becomes numbered waypoints, the cavebot repeats it in fast laps, and on the drop it handles the lure, the stairs and the loot on the way — then real gameplay of the character walking off alone, and the close 'Grava uma vez. Ele repete.'
claims: cavebot: rotas por waypoints com recorder (grava a rota)
o cavebot repete a rota sozinho (100% AFK)
combate com lure e loot; escadas no cavebot (changelog 21/02/2026: escadas corrigidas)
gameplay real do KizuBot (kit/video/rypherior.mp4, 29.3–32.0 s: o char segue sozinho pro próximo ponto)

notes: Hook kept as the concept's idea but set as a question, 'COMO ELE ANDA SOZINHO?', in 3 lines; the bot marker on the map is labelled 'KIZUBOT' from frame 0 as the early brand cue. Caption 1 trimmed to 'grava a rota uma vez' and the proof caption to 'na hunt de verdade' (the clip itself carries the 'gameplay real' tag) to stay one line at ≥56 px. The map, rooms and icons are a generic illustration; lure creatures are plain dots (no creature art). Real clip: rypherior.mp4 from 29.3 s (ASSETS: originals safe, muted; nothing on screen says 'boss', so no boss label). Route draw uses the path's real length (1990 px) because pathLength-normalized dash offsets snapped in this renderer. Loop bridge returns to the hook.
